note: W = the one-call value; R = the rebuild from daily calls. relW = |W−R|/|W| (pairs with |W| ≥ 1000); relG = |W−R|/Σ|d| over the inclusive window. signAgree over pairs where both |W| and |R| ≥ 250000. within = |W−R| ≤ 5% of max(|W|,|R|), both-zero pairs count as within. best = the rebuild with the highest within share; verdict MATCH ≥ 0.9, PARTIAL ≥ 0.5, else NO MATCH.
